$comment: Skills allowed to ship with a contract but no executable eval.
Every skill in src/skills/ must declare `acceptance.criteria`. A skill may
additionally declare `acceptance.cases`, which makes those criteria runnable
against a fixture — that is what `npm run eval` executes.
A skill with no cases must be listed here. `npm run build:check` fails when:
· a skill has no cases and is not listed  → new skill shipped without an eval
· a skill has cases but is still listed   → stale entry, delete the line
· a listed skill no longer exists         → stale entry, delete the line
The list only shrinks. Adding to it is a deliberate, reviewable act; write
the fixture instead whenever you can.
